notes: The ויהי frame's complementizer is not written in this verse; the that opening v.2 is carried by that verse's apodosis waw under rule 45.
מסביב is read as rule 40's whole-expression case: the compound round about belongs whole to סביב, headed on round, and the מן is unrepresented since no word states its own relation.

אחרי אשר is fused to the single when under rule 30 and headed on the governing preposition (rule 23); the after standing before many days is the temporal מן's, and the competing reading is named in the unit note.
The and between זקן and בא is added: the Hebrew juxtaposes the two predicates with no conjunction (rule 14's closing sentences).
